Data.CultureInvariantString: Eli will be an idealist from now on.
Data.Name: NotificationText

Data.CultureInvariantString: Eli will be a realist from now on.
Data.Name: NotificationText

Data.CultureInvariantString: Eli will be a cynic from now on.
Data.Name: NotificationText

Value.CultureInvariantString: Next
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Sun's been harsh lately, and it's been a chore to get any work done during the day.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: That said, I'm enjoying the field work.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It's been almost six months, and the climate is starting to get to me.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I miss the City. I miss my apartment.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I miss beds. Pillows. Cafés and streets.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Not much to do out here, besides work.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I've started zoning out, thinking about everything back home.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It wouldn't be so bad if I only knew how much longer this would take.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Never believed in that stuff, but this goes beyond mere luck. According to Jorge, no team that HQ has sent beyond the wall has ever returned alive.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Which will make our return a historic first. And that's not even factoring in the discovery of the Artifact.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I think he's just messing with me, though. There's no record of any expeditions outside the wall since Science City's formation.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Best not to think about that, though.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: To be fair, that's to be expected. According to Jorge, no team HQ's sent outside the wall has ever returned, which means our research on the area is extremely limited.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I think he's just messing with me, though. There's no record of any expeditions outside the wall since Science City's formation.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It also means we're going to be pioneers. Even if we return empty handed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Best not to think about that, though.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Aug 14th. Still alive, believe it or not. No signs of radiation poisoning in either of us. We've been hit by a dust storm, however, but it's been manageable and far from as dangerous as we were led to believe.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It's almost as if we're being guided by the Shepherd's staff.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: To say we're lucky is an understatement.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm beginning to think the dangers have been overblown.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Jorge says no team has ever returned from outside the Wall, which makes our research on the area fairly limited.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Which will make our return a historic first. And that's not even factoring in the discovery of this Artifact.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Best not to think about that, though.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Progress aside, the past few days have been...strange. Jorge mentioned a low hum from the digsite, and we've both been feeling unexplainably uneasy.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (GAIN TRAIT: IDEALIST) I think it's our tools that are reacting with the sedimentary chemicals in the pit, but the excavation should be over soon.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (GAIN TRAIT: REALIST) More likely than not, we've been out here a bit too long and are starting to get a little funny.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (GAIN TRAIT: CYNIC) The wasteland is supposed to be riddled with radiation. I'm surprised we're still alive, to be honest.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We made something of a breakthrough at the start of the week, but we're still working on the pods.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Once we manage to crack them open, we'll have a better idea of what we're dealing with.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm a little worried about them.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I wake up early on some days, and I leave the tent just to stare out at the wasteland.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I feel like it stares back.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I feel small and inconsequential.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We're out here until we "get results", whatever that means.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: There's too much we don't know.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm confident we will.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: They didn't give us much during our briefing. Just a mountain of gear, some coordinates, and an instruction to dig. Still no idea what they're expecting us to find.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Whatever it is, Jorge's eager to dig it up.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: At least I'm not alone.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I just want it over with.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I look at the digsite every day. The pods, the markings. I find myself wondering whether we should be here.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Jorge's less worried.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: We haven't talked much about it.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'd leave, if I could. Head back to the City.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Jorge's the silent type. We've been out here with only each other for company, and he's slow to warm up.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I've warmed up to him, too. He's a good guy.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: He's a good co-worker.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Warming up to him is slow, too.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Me and Jorge have that in common. I'm not sure if it's because he thinks the work is pointless or if it's just that he misses his family.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: We don't talk much. But that might be for the best.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Maybe he's just sick of dealing with me.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Probably a mixture of both. He keeps referring to our deployment as a "punishment".
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: He's out there right now. "Today's the day," he told me this morning. He's been saying that all week.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I've warmed up to him, too. He's a good guy.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Not used to him being that optimistic.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I really think the disappointment's starting to take its toll on him.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: That said, he seems to see my academic background as a shortcut out of paying my dues.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: He's been at this for decades and we're in the same role, so it's hard to argue with him.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: But we all pay our dues in different ways. His with tools, mine with theory.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I think he's just jealous. Maybe a little bitter, too.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We'll be fine. After this sprint, we'll be able to sample the dig and continue with sterilization.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: If we can loosen one of those pods, we might have our ticket back to the City.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I wonder who was the last person to see what we're seeing.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm excited, thinking about it. I feel like we're getting close.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I doubt Jorge and I would have given each other the time of day outside of work. But I'm grateful to have his expertise.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: We're getting there. Together, slowly.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It's hard to tell if the feeling is mutual.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: His paranoia, on the other hand, I could do without.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: He's pushing too hard, and I feel like he's expecting me to do the same.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm doing my best to keep up. We're getting there.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I do what I can, but I won't overwork myself.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: ...I should talk to him about that, actually.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: The only redeeming factor is that we get to be autonomous. No oversight or endless paperwork. Just good old-fashioned science.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I suppose we'll see if the tone changes if we find something.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Woo-hoo.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I did. It's just clear that our input isn't very interesting to the higher-ups. I'll bet that whoever is overseeing these expeditions never even set a foot in Science City.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: They might be more inclined to listen once we come back with something good.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: A scientist should know better.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I've been thinking a lot about this lately. Cram boxes upon boxes of expensive lab tech into a truck, drive it out into the wasteland, and dump all of it along with two scientists. And then? Nothing.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: No support.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: No visits.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: A single radio call every week. That's it.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Whatever it is they're interested in us finding, that's the extent of it. Somewhere back in the City, there's a checklist of what was sent here. I wouldn't be surprised if me and Jorge are listed amongside the equipment. If that.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I need to stop focusing on the negative.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: At least journaling spares Jorge from all this complaining.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: The sun is brutal, even when filtered through the dust clouds. No doubt it'd make you a little woozy.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I need to start covering up more when out in the open.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Can't let that get to me. Our work is too important.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: What I wouldn't give for an air-conditioned office in Science City.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I almost forgot. I had a look at some of my previous journal entries today.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (CYNIC) I hate reading my old notes.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (IDEALIST) We've come so far, and learned so much. I'm astounded by this place, to be frank.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: (REALIST) We've constantly been proving ourselves wrong about this place. That's good.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I had no strong feelings about those notes. None whatsoever.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Seems doable.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: With science, anything is possible.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I could also wear a scarf over my head.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Jorge would agree with that. If nothing else, we could take breaks mid-day, when the sun is doing its worst.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Seems reasonable enough.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Good luck convincing Jorge of a siesta.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Elevators, vending machines, coffee machines... Newspapers.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I miss the comforts.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I miss people.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I miss having a moment to myself at the end of the day.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: That goes for whatever's down that pit, too.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Guess we'll see.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It might be nothing. I shouldn't get my hopes up.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Like a pirate.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Yeah.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: On second thought, no.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Time well spent going over research, at the very least.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm sure I can convince Jorge to do that.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Or taking a break, for once.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: There'll be other things. The dig isn't the only thing that needs doing.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: We've got experiments to run. Research to write down.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Then again, a siesta doesn't sound so bad.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I've even thought about just bailing and heading back to the city, but hiking through the desert is a death sentence. I swear, it's like they put no thought into this deployment. The equipment they gave us is so general it's left us prepared for everything and nothing at the same time.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: This whole expedition's been poorly managed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I told them, even.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It makes no sense.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: They seem small enough. Unless they go deeper than expected. You could hold one on either arm.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Like a baby.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Like a trophy.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Like a small, trophy-sized baby pod.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: The metal covers and the signage is familiar enough. This was probably a research facility. Or an outpost, at the very least.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: No clue who ran it, though.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: No language barrier.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Weirdly familiar, in a way.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: It's like there's something just beneath us, waiting to be discovered.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Whack the ground beside you.] You hear that, something? I'm coming for you.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: There better be, after all this work.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Good thing, too. Not sure how easy it would be to haul anything bigger back to the city. Especially with all our equipment.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fingers crossed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Hope they bring trucks.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Good thing, too. Not sure how easy it would be to haul anything bigger back to the city. Especially with all our equipment.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fingers crossed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Hope they bring trucks.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Good thing, too. Not sure how easy it would be to haul anything bigger back to the city. Especially with all our equipment.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fingers crossed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Hope they bring trucks. Or something that'll carry many small, trophy-sized baby pods.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: When I get back to the City, I'm having waffles for a week. For all meals.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Soon, Eli. Soon.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I already regret thinking that. I miss waffles.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Friends, lovers. Man, I even miss my family.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: It's alright. One evening back with the parents, and I'll remember why I took this job in the first place.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Shit, I should call mom. Some other day.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: There's always the wasteland. Impressive to look at, but pretty dull sights for an evening stroll.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: The novelty wore off after the first two months.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Then again, I guess the exercise is good.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'm surprised we don't know more about the history of these sites. As far as I understand, Jorge and I aren't the only researchers working outside the wall.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I should look into it when I'm back in the City.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I should ask about it on the next call with HQ.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [Suddenly, a shiver runs up your spine, and you press the pen firmly against the journal page. Somewhere outside the tent, you swear you can hear Jorge calling out for you.]
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Raise your voice] ...Jorge? Did you say something?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Listen closely]
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I'm not sure how high in standing we'll be when we return - I suppose that hinges on what we bring back with us - but maybe we'll have enough sway to get to look into some of the more classified records in Science City.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Fingers crossed.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: They better let us.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: [There's another scream, more desperate this time. He sounds distressed.]
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Get up]
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: So many false and hasty conclusions. I know it's part of the process, but it's exhausting to go through. Part of me wants to get rid of everything I've ever written. At least then I'd be the best version of myself I could be.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: If only, on paper.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I can't just erase anything I've ever said or done, though. As much as I'd like to.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: Progress has come at a snail's pace. But at least we're moving. We could be dead in the water. Instead, we're engaged in pleasant backstroke towards a reasonable conclusion.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Pleasant backstroke. Not bad, Eli.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: [Shake your head, erasing what you just wrote.]
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: I guess because I've lived all of it already, thought all of it once before. There's nothing new in here.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Frankly, I'm tired of reading them.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I should probably write something more interesting.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: It's not every day you get to be at the forefront of discovery. Whatever we find, I can't help but think it'll be of great significance.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I wonder if they'll name something after us.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm just happy to be along for the ride.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We don't really stray far away from the digsite. There's plenty of work to do. Promising work.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Promising, but slow.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: That said, it's hard to stay focused.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I get the feeling we're about to come across something big.
Value.Name: Text

Data.CultureInvariantString: We got here early spring, and back then, the temperatures were more bearable.
Data.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: The work's exciting, but sometimes it's just too damn hot.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I find myself spacing out more often than I used to.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I'm worried about winter. We're not equipped for that.
Value.Name: Text
